description: Two independent halves, each holding a pair of attack-release envelopes: a first one fired by its own gate and a second that follows after a set delay, both with end-of-cycle triggers

params.text: Sets the attack time of the first envelope, 12 microseconds at fully counter-clockwise to 12 seconds at fully clockwise, the setting squared; its Fast button shortens that to half a second
Sets the attack time of the second envelope, 12 microseconds at fully counter-clockwise to 12 seconds at fully clockwise, the setting squared; its Fast button shortens that to half a second
Sets the release time of the first envelope, 12 microseconds at fully counter-clockwise to 12 seconds at fully clockwise, the setting squared along the way
Sets the release time of the second envelope, 12 microseconds at fully counter-clockwise to 12 seconds at fully clockwise, the setting squared along the way
Bends both envelopes of that half from nearly logarithmic at -0.99, through straight at 0, to exponential at 0.99
Sets how long after the first envelope is triggered the second one starts, 1 millisecond to 1 second
Holds both envelopes at full while the gate is above 0.5V, turning them from attack-release into attack-sustain-release
Multiplies the first envelope's attack and release times by 0.5 instead of 12, so its longest stage becomes half a second
Multiplies the second envelope's attack and release times by 0.5 instead of 12, so its longest stage becomes half a second

inputs.text: Divided by 5 and added to the A1 knob, the total clamped to the knob's own range before it is squared
Divided by 5 and added to the A2 knob, the total clamped to the knob's own range before it is squared
Divided by 5 and added to the R1 knob, the total clamped to the knob's own range before it is squared
Divided by 5 and added to the R2 knob, the total clamped to the knob's own range before it is squared
Divided by 5 and multiplied by the Shape knob, so the knob becomes an attenuverter over this jack; the total is clamped to -1 and 1
The absolute value of the voltage, divided by 5, is added to the 2 Delay knob, the total clamped to 1 second
Any rise away from 0V starts the first envelope; while AR/ASR is on, a level above 0.5V also holds both envelopes at full

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 0.08 seconds long when the first envelope reaches the end of its release
A 10V pulse 0.08 seconds long when the second envelope reaches the end of its release

notes: the two halves share nothing: each has its own gate, its own pair of envelopes and its own set of knobs
retriggering an envelope part way through picks the phase up from where it had got to rather than jumping back to zero
every output is monophonic, whatever is patched in
